text: The heads of the fathers' houses of the clan of the sons of Gilead son of Machir son of Manasseh, from the clans of the sons of Joseph, came forward. They spoke before Moses and before the leaders, the heads of the fathers' houses of the Israelites.

versions.text: The heads of the fathers' houses of the clan of the sons of Gilead son of Machir son of Manasseh, from the clans of the sons of Joseph, came forward and spoke before Moses and before the leaders, the heads of the fathers' houses of the Israelites.
versions.explanation: The verse is a single very long sentence with two long appositional strings, which is hard to read aloud in one breath. Splitting at the two Hebrew verbs ("came forward" / "spoke") preserves the sense and improves oral rhythm.

text: They said, "The LORD commanded my lord to give the land as an inheritance by lot to the Israelites, and my lord was commanded by the LORD to give the inheritance of our brother Zelophehad to his daughters.

Now if they marry men from another of the Israelite tribes, their inheritance will be taken from the inheritance of our fathers and added to the inheritance of the tribe they marry into; so it will be taken from the portion allotted to us.

And when the Jubilee comes for the Israelites, their inheritance will be added to the inheritance of the tribe they have married into, and their inheritance will be taken away from the inheritance of our fathers' tribe."
So at the word of the LORD, Moses commanded the Israelites: "What the tribe of the sons of Joseph says is right.
This is what the LORD has commanded concerning the daughters of Zelophehad: They may marry whomever they please, but they must marry within a clan of their father's tribe.

versions.text: This is what the LORD commands concerning the daughters of Zelophehad: They may marry whomever they please, but they must marry within a clan of their father's tribe.
versions.explanation: The Hebrew verb צִוָּה is a completed action ("has commanded"), matching the perfect used in verse 2 and the framing of verse 5; the present tense "commands" slightly obscures that Moses is reporting a command already given.

text: No inheritance of the Israelites shall pass from tribe to tribe, for each of the Israelites shall hold to the inheritance of the tribe of his fathers.
Every daughter who inherits property in any of the Israelite tribes shall marry someone from a clan of her father's tribe, so that each of the Israelites may keep the inheritance of his fathers.
No inheritance shall pass from one tribe to another, for each of the Israelite tribes shall hold to its own inheritance."
The daughters of Zelophehad did just as the LORD commanded Moses.
Mahlah, Tirzah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Noah, the daughters of Zelophehad, married sons of their father's brothers.
They married within the clans of the descendants of Manasseh son of Joseph, and their inheritance remained with the tribe of their father's clan.

versions.text: They married within the clans of the descendants of Manasseh son of Joseph, and their inheritance remained in their father's clan and tribe.
versions.explanation: The Hebrew reads "with the tribe of the clan of their father"; the current rendering "their father's clan and tribe" turns a construct chain into a compound and slightly alters the emphasis on the tribe as the holder of the inheritance.

text: These are the commandments and ordinances that the LORD gave through Moses to the Israelites on the plains of Moab by the Jordan across from Jericho.
